reference: Retained real-Conductor REA/source JNi→AAo→GTo→OTo→uCe→wNi→Wko→jko. GTo disables sorting when visible rows <=1, not expanded, or editing; the actual consumer omits drag-handle props and rejects disabled reorder.
claim: Singleton display rows must not expose enabled dragging. Current singleton self-drop/order preservation is already PARITY. No native/physical gesture or data-mutation defect is claimed.

harness_contract.subject: Full actual exported Composer mounting its actual QueuePanel and QueueRow, with actual queue reducers and dropOrder imports. No copied drag logic or product replacement.
harness_contract.seed: Working active turn with real queued messages, normal enabled controls, no fabricated disabled state. Queue attachments remain carried by actual reducers.
harness_contract.ports: Editor imperative focus and exact rendered-list focus ports are test boundaries. DataTransfer-shaped drag payload port records calls; it is not browser File/DataTransfer fabrication or native observation.
harness_contract.disabled_interaction: Never call onDragStart when rendered draggable is false; assert the rendered affordance. On baseline where it is true, enabled dragstart may be invoked to observe the actual handler. Never invoke a disabled button callback.
harness_contract.assertions: All case names, executable expectations, order and fixture bytes freeze before RED. Setup, import, transpile, skips, cancellations or unhandled errors do not count as semantic RED.
harness_contract.runtime: No Node/parser/test/build/browser/native until an explicit serialized ledger admission. This oracle authorizes no runtime. Product treatment remains unstarted.

cases.name: singleton/initial visible row is not draggable
cases.expectation: One visible q1, no collapse toggle, draggable false; queue/actions/effects unchanged.

cases.name: singleton/expanded shrink to one disables remaining row
cases.expectation: Delete q1 from working two-row queue via enabled Delete action; q2 survives, draggable false; preserve its attachment and no provider effects.

cases.name: singleton/collapsed shrink reveals non-draggable survivor
cases.expectation: Collapse two-row queue then actual turn completion drains q1; q2 visible, no expand toggle, draggable false; only the expected start effect.

cases.name: singleton/Cancel edit restores focus but not dragging
cases.expectation: Edit singleton then enabled Cancel; q1 is visible, focus restored once, draggable false; no content/effect change.

cases.name: singleton/Save edit restores focus but not dragging
cases.expectation: Edit singleton, change to nonblank text, enabled Save; q1 visible with new text, focus restored once, draggable false; no effect.

cases.name: singleton/session remount does not expose dragging
cases.expectation: Switch keyed Composer session from multirow queue to independently seeded singleton; singleton visible and draggable false; no leaked focus or action.

cases.name: control/empty queue renders no draggable row
cases.expectation: No li row, no queue list or collapse toggle, no actions/effects.

cases.name: control/expanded multirow rows remain draggable
cases.expectation: All three visible display rows draggable true, unchanged queue/actions/effects.

cases.name: control/enabled dragstart writes payload and sets own drag state
cases.expectation: Enabled q2 dragstart writes text/plain q2 with move effect and q2 dragging class; no queue/provider action.

cases.name: control/enabled distinct-target drop preserves full reorder payload
cases.expectation: Start q1 and drop onto q3; actual reorder action IDs q2,q3,q1; all original messages/attachments preserved by reducer; dragging cleared.

cases.name: control/self drop is already a no-op
cases.expectation: Start enabled q2 and drop q2; no reorder action, items unchanged and dragging cleared. This is parity, not a target failure.

cases.name: control/foreign dragover and drop do not reorder
cases.expectation: Without own dragstart, dragover not accepted; drop causes no reorder or item change. Do not invent an own drag by directly writing state.

cases.name: control/dragend clears own drag state without reordering
cases.expectation: Start enabled q2 then dragend; dragging class cleared, no action/effect.

cases.name: control/active edit disables other display rows
cases.expectation: Edit q2; q1/q3 display rows draggable false; editing li has no drag handlers. No disabled dragstart invoked.

cases.name: control/collapsed multirow has no visible drag target
cases.expectation: Enabled Collapse action hides all rows/list, Expand restores enabled display rows with queue identity preserved.

cases.name: control/1474 blank edit cannot save or begin dragging
cases.expectation: Blank edit disables Save and Save-and-steer, Enter/meta-Enter consumed without mutation; remaining display rows disabled; no disabled callbacks invoked.

cases.name: control/1476 singleton regrowth stays expanded and restores multirow dragging
cases.expectation: Collapse two-row queue, completion shrinks to q2, actual queued submit adds q3; both rows visible/draggable, no Expand toggle; expected drain only.

cases.name: control/1479 removed edited row never receives return focus
cases.expectation: Edit q2 then external actual remove reducer; q1/q3 visible, no removed-row focus/query, remaining rows draggable, no provider effect.

cases.name: control/1479 session-key switch cannot focus old edited row
cases.expectation: Edit q2 then remount keyed Composer for another three-row session; no old display-row focus/query, new queue untouched, no actions beyond initial edit.

cases.name: control/1479 Save-and-steer removes edited row without return focus
cases.expectation: Edit q2, nonblank Save-and-steer; q1/q3 remain draggable, expected steer effect and preserved attachments, no removed-target focus/query.

scope_limits: No broad focus manager or drag framework replacement
No overlapping owner or unreserved runtime
